crop.notes: Clipping is the 'Crimson and Blue' column (football, Greggains-Costello, Dixon, Al Smith). Only the headline deck mentions Allen; the Mitchell letter itself is under 'The Ring' in a later column on the page, not in this clipping (it is article 877).

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch headlined its sporting page with a letter Charley Mitchell wrote to Tom Allen, saying he would give Corbett a surprise before the tenth round; the letter appears in a separate item.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday Evening, November 19, 1892, page 8.

notes: Headline for the letter text in article 877; consider merging 876 into 877 or recropping. Facts recorded under 877.
